newsitem.title: USA: Phelps Dodge reiterates Chino offer is final.
newsitem.headline: Phelps Dodge reiterates Chino offer is final.

text.p: Phelps Dodge Corp's Treasurer Tom Foster reiterated Wednesday that the company's offer, presented last year, to workers at Chino copper mine in New Mexico was final.
Phelps and the United Steelworkers of America union leaders meet Thursday and Friday in Las Cruces, N.M.
Foster described the two-days as meetings requested by the union. "They are not negotiations," Foster said.
"We are going to sit down and answer whatever questions they might have on the final offer that we made last August. The union has never offered this to our employees to vote on," Foster added.
Phelps' offer would freeze pay at the Chino mine. The USWA said earlier Wednesday it was still seeking a pay hike.
"The mine has been running uneventfully and at full capacity," Foster said.
Workers at Chino have been without a labor contract since June 30 last year.
